name: Izifo zesikhumba ezibangelwa ukhunta
tagline: Unyawo lomsubathi, umbandamu, ijoki itch. Kushibhile ukwelapha.

what_is_it.heading: Izifo zesikhumba ze-fungal ngokwemibandela ecacile
what_is_it.lede: Izifo zesikhumba zesikhunta zibangelwa isikhunta esincane esingenabungozi esihlala ezingxenyeni ezifudumele nezimanzi zomzimba. Uma sezikhule ngokweqile, zibangela ukulunywa, ama-scaly, ngokuvamile amise okwendandatho. Kuyacasula kodwa ngokuvamile kulula ukuyelapha.
paragraphs: Izinhlobo ezivamile: unyawo lomsubathi (phakathi kwezinzwane), i-jock itch (igroin), i-ringworm (noma yikuphi - empeleni isikhunta, hhayi isibungu), ukhunta wezinzipho, umbandamu wesikhumba ezinganeni. Naphezu kwamagama ahlukene, wonke abangelwa isikhunta esifanayo.

Iningi liphendula ukhilimu we-antifungal we-ngaphandle kwegqirha ofakwe amaviki angu-2-4. Ezinye - ukhunta wezinzipho, izifo zesikhumba - zidinga amaphilisi kadokotela. Abantu abanesifo sikashukela, amasosha omzimba abuthakathaka, noma i-HIV bangase bathole izifo ezimbi kakhulu noma eziphindelelayo.

items.headline: Okujwayelekile kakhulu
items.body: Unyawo lomsubathi lulodwa luthinta abantu abadala abangafika ku-70% ngesikhathi esithile. I-ringworm kanye ne-jock itch kuvamile emhlabeni jikelele.

items.headline: Kulula ukwelapha
items.body: Izifo eziningi zesikhunta ziyacaca ngokhilimu othengwayo emasontweni angu-2-4. Kushibhile, kutholakala kunoma yiliphi ikhemisi.

items.headline: Iyathathelana
items.body: Isikhunta sisakazeka kumathawula, phansi eshaweni, kumata wokuzivocavoca, ezicathulweni ezihlanganyelwe. Yilaphe — futhi ungabelani ngamathawula noma izicathulo ngesikhathi sokwelashwa.

items.headline: Gcina womile
items.body: Ukhunta uthanda isikhumba esifudumele, esimanzi. Yomisa kahle ngemva kokugeza, shintsha amasokisi ajulukile nezingubo zangaphansi, khipha umoya izicathulo. Ukuvimbela kumayelana nokomisa.

pull_quote.text: Uma 'indandatho' esikhumbeni ingaqedi ngokhilimu we-antifungal emavikini angu-4, bonana nodokotela. Ezinye izimo zesikhumba zibukeka njengezikelemu - futhi ukhilimu we-steroid uzokwenza isibanda sangempela sibe sibi nakakhulu.

signs.heading: Amaphethini ajwayelekile
signs.lede: Izifo zesikhunta zonke zifana nokuluma, uqweqwe, nokubukeka okumise okwendandatho - kodwa lapho zivela khona kuyehluka.

items.title: Unyawo lomdlali
items.description: Isikhumba esilumayo, esiqhekekayo, esixebuka phakathi kwezinzwane - ikakhulukazi isi-4 kanye nesi-5. Ingasakazeka ematheni. Uyanuka. Kuba kubi ehlobo kanye nezicathulo ezijulukayo.

items.title: Isikelemu (tinea corporis)
items.description: Ibala elibomvu elijikelezayo (noma elimnyama, esikhumbeni esiMnyama) elinesikhumba esimaphakathi esicacile — sibukeka njengendandatho. Kancane kancane ikhula ngaphandle. Okujwayelekile ezingalweni, intamo, umzimba. Kuyaluma.

items.title: Jock itch kanye ne-scalp tinea
items.description: I-Jock itch: ukuqubuka okubomvu, okulumayo emagoqeni e-groin - okuvamile emadodeni, ngemva kokujuluka. I-scalp ringworm: ukulahleka kwezinwele ezimagqabhagqabha ngokukalwa - kuvame ezinganeni, kudinga amaphilisi.

spreads.heading: Ukuthi izifo zefungal zisakazeka kanjani
yes: Ukuthintana okuqondile kwesikhumba nesikhumba nomuntu onegciwane
Amathawula ahlanganyelwe, ilineni lombhede, izingubo zokugqoka, amabhulashi ezinwele
Ukuhamba ungafake zicathulo ezitezi ezingcolile - amashawa omphakathi, amagumbi okushintshela ejimini, amadekhi echibi lokubhukuda
Kusukela kumishini yokujuluka ezindaweni zokujima noma kwezemidlalo

prevention.heading: Ungakugwema kanjani ukuyithola futhi
prevention.lede: Isikhunta siyabuya uma izimo zihlala zifudumele futhi zimanzi. Imikhuba emincane yansuku zonke ivimbela ukuphindaphinda okuningi.

items.title: Yomisa kahle ngemva kokugeza
items.description: Ikakhulukazi phakathi kwezinzwane, e-groin, ngaphansi kwamabele, emiphethweni yesikhumba. Ome kancane. Isikhumba esomile siyikhaya elingenabungane lesikhunta.

items.title: Ukotini ohlanzekile, shintsha njalo
items.description: Amasokisi kakotini nezingubo zangaphansi ziphefumula kangcono kunezokwenziwa. Shintsha nsuku zonke nangemva kokujuluka. Ungaphinde ugqoke izingubo zokuzivocavoca ezijulukayo.

items.title: Ungahambi ungagqokanga izicathulo emphakathini
items.description: Amashawa omphakathi, amagumbi okushintshela ejimini, amadekhi echibi lokubhukuda - gqoka izihlikihli noma izimbadada. Izifo eziningi zezinyawo ze-fungal zivela kulezi zindawo.

items.title: Ungabelani ngamathawula noma izicathulo
items.description: Ngisho namalungu omndeni. Uma othile enokutheleleka kwefungal, sebenzisa amathawula ahlukene kuze kube yilapho esesuliwe.

items.title: Qala ngaphandle kwegqirha antifungal cream
items.description: I-Clotrimazole noma i-terbinafine - gcoba kabili ngosuku endaweni ethintekile kanye no-2cm ukuyizungezile. Qhubeka amasonto ama-2 ngemva kokuba ukuqhuma kuphelile ukuze uvimbele ukubuya.

items.title: Gcina indawo yomile futhi ivuleleke emoyeni
items.description: Ungabhandishi. Gqoka izingubo ezixegayo. Vumela isikhumba siphefumule. Impushana (hhayi ukhilimu) ekuseni ingasiza emabeleni noma ezinyaweni ekumunceni umjuluko.

items.title: Phatha umthombo
items.description: Geza wonke amathawula, izingubo zokulala, nezingubo ezithinte isifo emanzini ashisayo. Lahla noma ubulale amagciwane izicathulo ezindala uma unyawo lomsubathi lulokhu lubuya.

items.title: Uma kungengcono emavikini angu-4 - bonana nodokotela
items.description: Ezinye izimo ezifanayo aziphenduli ku-antifungal. Ukhunta lwezinzipho kanye nezikelemu zasekhanda zidinga amaphilisi. Imitholampilo kahulumeni ihlinzeka ngazo zombili mahhala.

items.title: Uma unesifo sikashukela noma i-HIV - hamba kusenesikhathi
items.description: Ukutheleleka kwesikhunta kungaba nzima kakhulu futhi kusakazeke ngokushesha. Yiya emtholampilo uma ubona kuqala — ungalindi ukuzama ezitolo amasonto.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Izifo eziningi zesikhunta zesikhumba ziyacaca ngokhilimu oshibhile otholakala ezitolo. Uma bengakwenzi, imitholampilo kahulumeni ihlinzeka ngokwelashwa kwencwadi kadokotela mahhala.

helplines.name: Noma yiliphi ikhemisi lendawo
helplines.description: Ama-antifungal creams angaphezu kwe-counter - clotrimazole, terbinafine
helplines.meta: Ayikho incwadi kadokotela edingekayo ukuze uthole ukhilimu

helplines.name: Thola umtholampilo oseduze nawe
helplines.description: Ukuhlolwa kwamahhala kanye nemithi yokwelashwa kwe-antifungal uma kudingeka
helplines.meta: Akukho ukuqokwa · alukho usizo lwezempilo oludingekayo
